chunks: Zurārah narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
“A woman in the state of ihram lets her garment hang down to her chest.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, the Imam from whom the ruling is narrated
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمَةَ: a woman who is in the state of ihram
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurārah, the narrator transmitting the hadith
key_terms.نَحْرِهَا: her upper chest or neckline area

ai.seo_question: How should a woman in the state of ihram let her garment hang?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman in the state of ihram. It states that she should let her garment hang down to her chest, indicating a specific manner of dress permitted or prescribed during hajj or ʿumrah observance.
